t: Can EPC Power Acquisition Boost Flex's AI Infrastructure Growth?
desc: Flex Ltd. has completed its acquisition of EPC Power, adding advanced power conversion and grid-forming technologies to its Cloud and Power Infrastructure (CPI) portfolio. EPC Power brings 15 GW of deployed technology and supports next-generation 800-volt data center systems. Flex expects 65-75% CPI revenue growth in fiscal 2027, ahead of its planned separation into Axiom Solutions International in Q1 calendar 2027.
